reviews.t: Go ahead and just buy them instead of the single thicker pro ones
reviews.x: LOVE these!!! I was looking for a professional acrylic brush and was going to go for the standard single kind that was like $17+. But I found these. I hesitated at first but decided to go for them since the pack came with so many different brushes for different uses. And I'm sooo glad I did! It's drcent quality. The bristles aren't as quick as some of the more professional ones but my nail beds are small so these actually work best for me.

Dealing with black coming off on to my nails and hands, because apparently the paint used on the handle does not stand up to odorless monomer. I want my money back but don’t want to bother sending these back. Not worth the time. Stay away from these if you plan to use them for anything involving acrylic nail application. My friend cleaned the black of the handles with rubbing alcohol, just so I could finish my manicure.
I use these brushes for nail art and even have used them to apply acrylic on. Good brushes!
Started doing my own nails and this was one of the best purchases made.

reviews.t: Very nice and easy to hold
reviews.x: I haven't actually used these yet but from the looks of it they are exactly what I wanted. The brushes are smaller and easier to control product. Will do an update for the quality soon.
Very good product. Always wanted to buy a set nail brush. This set of brush is very smooth, very soft, very easy to use. Any style can be made with a different brush.
Gifted to a nail art loving coworker and now every day she comes in with amazing cool designs using my brushes. 5 stars!

I just wanted these brushes to help clean up the edges of my nails. I found the brushes didn't hold the acetone well and it was difficult to remove the excess polish. DO NOT get acetone on the black because the color will come off and stain your hands and anything else around. The price is good, but the quality is sub par. I guess you get what you paid for.

reviews.t: Great 3D art brush super amazing price
reviews.x: Perfect set ! Has a dotting tool, cuticle cleaner and 3D nail art brush !! I used the 3D art brush for some flowers and it worked great the acrylic didn’t get stuck on the brush like I thought it would.
After one use the acrylic brushes became disposable. The black handles rubbed off & got all over my hands & table. Poorly made, would not recommend or repurchase.
I do not like the brushes. I should’ve went with my first thought which was not getting them. They do not do the job!! I regret buying
i bought for structure gel and builder gel.  I am happy with the brushes.
They suck bc I only got to use them one time and then they broke
Its okay the paint on the brushes come off easily.

While they're great for using to clean up my nail polish when designing I thought they would make the handles at least resistance to Acetone since that's what most people would be using to clean their nails, but nope when acetone gets on the black handles at first it removes the color and then it starts melting the handle itself. Be warned. I still use them regularly though despite the melting handle.

reviews.t: These brushes are of very bad quality and not at all dueable
reviews.x: I bought this brush for nail art thinking it will be of good and durable bit it is NOT. The hair brush came off while cleaning the brush after use. It happened to all of the brush in a set. I would not recommend this product to buy. Very cheap material. Not willing to give a single star but can not choose lower than that.

I like the variety of this set, but I was frustrated that the coating on the handles began to corrode almost immediately that any acetone touched it. I could expect this from makeup brushes, because you don't use acetone with makeup, but you commonly use acetone with nail art - so I was surprised.

These are probably great art brushes for nails but my daughter used them for an acrylic set and they completely fell apart.  They are a great value with different sizes. I would not recommend them for anything other than decorative nail art as the bristles dont hold up.

Acrylic nail art brush I got them as a gift for my sister in law so like to do people nails and always looking for  new brushes so you she got extra one on hand she just loved them and like that there are very high quality and very easy to use

Son perfectos para realizar diseños a mano alzada, para pintar las uñas. Las cerdas son excelentes, la calidad una maravilla. Recuerden que cualquier diseño a mano alzada en uñas se realiza mejor con gel paint, o paiting gel.

Black on the handle comes off if your going to buy these for nail art I would your wet products will take the black paint off. However they are nice brushes so if you do buy put a coat of top coat polish on them.

Was so excited to try these out after all the good reviews.. tried one and had to throw it away, bristles started falling out on my nail in the nail acrylic.. hopefully the others work better than the first one..

I find these brushes counterproductive because the black paint on the handles rubs off onto your fingers if they get nail polish remover on them. I'm super disappointed because I need to use something else
I love the variety of brushes offered in the package. Beware that if you are using it for gel nails, be sure to get the proper cleaner because the gel will stick to your brush and cause it to harden.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brushes easy to use and good value, especially for beginners and DIY nail art.
Several reviewers report the black paint on the handles comes off and stains hands, nails, and surfaces, especially when exposed to acetone or monomer.
Some reviewers complain about poor durability, with brushes breaking or becoming unusable after one use.
A few reviewers were disappointed that the brushes did not perform the job they needed.
Some reviewers praise the variety of brushes in the set for different nail art uses.
